rationale: The diff exactly matches the three removals specified in the spec and plan. The spec's safety claim for LLMSelector is verified by source: in AssistantSetupSection (non-compact path) the LLMSelector sits inside a w-72 container, so removing max-w-sm from the wrapper has no visible effect there; in VirtualAssistantForm the constraint is passed through the className prop to the inner MultiSelect, not the wrapper div, so it is unaffected; in ChatConfigLlmSelector and ChatConfigImageGeneration no className is passed at all and the wrapper now correctly fills its panel container. The AssistantSetupSection fix is gated exclusively behind isCompactView, confirming zero impact on the standalone assistant form page.
follow_ups: VirtualAssistantForm.tsx line 332 passes className='grow max-w-sm' to LLMSelector. That className flows to the inner MultiSelect element, not the outer wrapper div, so the wrapper change does not affect it — but this site has its own max-w-sm on the inner element which may warrant a separate review if that panel ever needs full-width layout.

ChatConfigLlmSelector renders LLMSelector with no className and no surrounding fixed-width container. Now that the wrapper no longer caps at max-w-sm, the dropdown grows to the full aside width. Visually this is the intended fix; a quick manual check that the aside width is reasonable at all breakpoints is advisable before merge.
